assets.bindingsEmpty: This asset currently has no bindings.
assets.desc: Look up an asset by id to see its metadata and bindings, and preview the original content (served as-is, never transcoded).
assets.downloadNote: GET /api/storage/download/{id}: in object-storage mode it only returns a presigned URL that expires; in local mode it streams directly. Not suitable as a long-lived reference.
assets.emptyState: Enter an asset id and look it up. The server requires readability: the uploader, a moderator, or a visible bound entity.
assets.hashVerified.no: No (unverified content is not reused for instant upload nor downloadable)
assets.idPlaceholder: Paste an asset uuid, or a URL containing one
assets.invalidId: That is not a valid uuid. An asset id is 36 hex characters (hyphens allowed).
assets.notReadable: Asset not found: it does not exist, or your account may not read it — the server answers 404 for both cases and does not distinguish, so other people's uploads are not disclosed.
assets.previewNotComplete: The asset is not complete yet (currently {status}); the content endpoint answers 404 for it. Preview once it completes.
assets.previewNote: The server authorizes each request and forwards the object as-is — no transcoding, no cropping; visibility is decided per request, so the response is private-cache only.
assets.previewUnsupported: Type {mime} cannot be previewed inline; open it with the address below.
assets.title: Asset lookup
bindings.assetEmpty: This asset currently has no bindings.
bindings.desc: Unbinding is a correction: the binding creator, the uploader or a moderator may do it, and the endpoint is not idempotent.
bindings.entityEmpty: No files are bound to this entity.
bindings.entityNotFound: The catalog service reports this entity as invisible (or missing), so its file list cannot be loaded.
bindings.invalidId: That is not a valid uuid; the server would treat it as not_found too.
bindings.notIdempotentBody: DELETE /api/storage/bindings/:id looks the binding up by id and then deletes it; on the second call the row is gone, so the server can only answer not_found. "Already gone" is not a failure — the UI reloads the data.
bindings.title: Binding removal
bindings.unbindBody: This removes "{role} → {target}". Only the binding is deleted; the file itself and other bindings are untouched, and restoring it requires binding again.
bindings.unbindDirectBody: This unbinds binding id {id} directly. There is no list to reload here (the server has no read-binding-by-id endpoint), so the result is reported as a notice; to check the blast radius, switch to the by-asset tab and look the asset id up.
bindings.unbindDone: Unbound. Note this endpoint is not idempotent: deleting the same id again returns 404, not "already unbound".
bindings.unbindForbidden: Only the binding creator, the uploader, or a moderator holding storage.asset.moderate can remove this binding.
bindings.unbindGone: That binding no longer exists (someone else may have removed it). Data was reloaded — the server's list is authoritative.
common.appSubtitle: Operations for physical assets, content addressing and bindings
errors.authentication_required: Not signed in or the session expired (the server answered authentication_required); please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: The server answered 403 forbidden: your account lacks the permission code this action needs.
errors.invalid_payload: The server rejected the request body (invalid_payload).
errors.module_error: Server-side failure (module_error): the database or object-storage step failed; retry later or check the server logs.
errors.network: The request could not be sent or got no response: {message}
errors.object_missing: The object's bytes are not in object storage (object_missing): the metadata is still there, but that content can no longer be fetched — retrying will not help.
errors.storage_unavailable: Object storage unavailable (storage_unavailable): the read/write step did not succeed.
meta.description: Operations for the MetaFusion storage domain: usage, asset lookup, binding removal.
meta.title: Storage Console · MetaFusion
overview.bytesHint: Scope: sum of size_bytes for those assets
overview.desc: Completed assets and occupied bytes registered in the storage service, read from GET /api/storage/stats.
overview.emptyUsage: The server reports zero completed assets.
overview.forbidden: Instance-wide usage is visible only to moderators holding storage.asset.moderate (it is not a public statistic). Ask an administrator to grant that code.
overview.noQuota: The server's /stats returns only assets and bytes — there is no quota field, so no utilization bar is drawn here; the denominator would have to be invented.
overview.pendingNote: Pending assets and assets that failed read-back verification are not counted in these two numbers.
overview.title: Usage overview
session.legacyFallback: This identity carries no permissions claim (legacy token, or an instance without permission groups); the UI falls back to the historical role exactly as the server does.
session.redirecting: Not signed in or the session expired; redirecting to the login page…
